reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthActionCategory predicate that all month-wide actions already call, rather than adding per-action checks.

duplication.why: The rule itself is single, but setZero gets a new hand-written categories/category_groups join that copies the three existing average queries instead of sharing one category-loading query, and each query must be edited to select goal_def.

placement.why: The rule stays in the predicate in budget/actions.ts, beside the month-wide actions that use it.

scope.why: Focused on the requested rule and its tests, with minor noise (re-indented SQL in set6MonthAvg, a redundant `c.*, c.goal_def`, odd indentation in the getBudgetData type).

maintainability.why: Dropping the includeHidden option simplifies the predicate and the rule is in one function, but the four separate category queries must each keep supplying the columns it needs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the three average actions all decide through shouldWriteMonthActionCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The new setZero query is a plain copy of the existing category join, not disguised.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts shouldWriteMonthActionCategory decides hidden, hidden-group, template and income for every month-wide action (each action's query only supplies the goal_def column).
